images.alt: Destroyed tent camp with mangled canvas shelters, debris, and personal belongings scattered on sandy ground after an Israeli airstrike on displaced Palestinians in Gaza
images.caption: Aftermath of an Israeli drone strike on a tent camp sheltering displaced Palestinians in Gaza. Israel has repeatedly targeted displacement camps during the so-called ceasefire.

images.alt: Palestinians gather around shrouded bodies of civilians in a mosque courtyard in Gaza City, mourning after Israeli airstrikes killed nine people across four residential apartments
images.caption: Palestinians mourn over the bodies of victims killed in Israeli airstrikes on four residential apartments in Gaza City on June 4, 2026. Nine Palestinians were killed, including four children, and entire families were wiped out.

images.alt: Young Palestinian fisherman Muhammad Musa Abu Giab, on the beach of Deir al-Balah in central Gaza.
images.caption: Palestinian fishermen on the beach of Deir al-Balah in central Gaza. Israel's naval blockade and live-fire policy against Gaza's fishermen have killed dozens since the genocide began, including 15-year-old Muhammad Abu Giab on June 7, 2026.
